Name: BAGI Sweet Gem Berry (cometkins' style)
Author: bunnyverse
Description:
♡ hello! ♡

This mod adds jelly and wine icons in cometkins' art style for the Sweet Gem Berry!~

I used the color palette of the Sweet Gem Berry from Better Crops and Foraging (BCaF) and the art style from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394?tab=files&file_id=24039]cometkins' BAGI Compatibility[/url] (the optional file from Better Artisan Goods).

Mods I use together:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6561]Sweet Gem Regrow by proudunicorn[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14222]Sweet Gem Berry Artisan by 1m0ss1[/url]﻿
